name: SAP BTP
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - Backend Developer - SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (C_CPE)
SAP Certified Associate - SAP Build Low-code/No-code Applications and Automations (C_LCNC)
tools: SAP BTP trial or enterprise account

beginner.summary: For developers, consultants and citizen developers new to SAP BTP. Covers the account model, services and environments, connecting to SAP systems, security basics, low-code apps and automation with SAP Build, a first CAP application on SAP HANA Cloud, Fiori elements and deployment.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of SAP business processes or software development
Can use a web browser, a code editor and a command line
An SAP BTP trial or training account
outcomes: Explain what SAP BTP offers and how its accounts are structured
Build low-code apps and automations with SAP Build
Build and deploy a first CAP application with a Fiori elements UI
Connect BTP to SAP systems securely

days.topic: SAP BTP Overview and Account Setup
subtopics: What SAP BTP is: application development, automation, integration, data, AI
days.lab_task: Create a trial account, set up a subaccount and a directory, assign entitlements for SAP Build and SAP HANA Cloud and list them with the btp CLI.
days.deliverable: Account structure screenshot and btp CLI output

days.topic: Runtimes: Cloud Foundry, Kyma and the ABAP Environment
subtopics: Spaces, orgs and quotas in Cloud Foundry
days.lab_task: Enable Cloud Foundry, create a space, push a sample Node.js app with cf push, bind a service instance to it and compare when you would choose Kyma or the ABAP environment instead.
days.deliverable: Running app URL, binding output and a runtime comparison
checks: Run cf env on the app
Service binding credentials appear in VCAP_SERVICES
Use case and cost given for each

days.topic: Connecting BTP to SAP Systems: Destinations and Cloud Connector
subtopics: Why on-premise systems need a connector
days.lab_task: Install Cloud Connector, connect it to the subaccount, expose an S/4HANA OData service, create a destination and test it from the cockpit.
days.deliverable: Cloud Connector configuration, destination and successful test
checks: Check the connector status in the cockpit
Call a path not exposed in Cloud Connector

days.topic: Security Basics: Identity, Roles and Trust
subtopics: SAP Cloud Identity Services: Identity Authentication
Trust between subaccounts and identity providers
days.lab_task: Connect the subaccount to Identity Authentication, require MFA, create a role collection for app users and show a user without it being refused.
days.deliverable: Trust configuration, role collection and test results
checks: Open the app without the role collection

days.topic: SAP Build Apps: Your First Low-Code Application
subtopics: When low-code is the right choice
days.lab_task: Build a low-code app that lists S/4HANA business partners through a destination, shows details and lets a user create a contact note with validation, then deploy it.
days.deliverable: Build app, deployed URL and demo
checks: Submit the form with an empty required field
Layout works on a phone screen

days.topic: SAP Build Process Automation: Workflows and Forms
days.lab_task: Build a purchase request approval process with a form, a business rule that routes by amount, two approval levels and an action that creates a purchase requisition in S/4HANA.
days.deliverable: Process, rules, form and monitoring screenshots
checks: Submit a request below the limit
One approval and the requisition is created
Submit a request above the limit
Requester is informed and nothing is created

days.topic: SAP Build Process Automation: Bots for Repetitive Tasks
days.lab_task: Build a bot that reads supplier invoices from email attachments, enters them into a test web form, logs results to Excel and handles a missing field without stopping.
days.deliverable: Automation project, run log and results file
checks: Run the bot on five emails
Include an email with a missing field
Logged as an exception and the bot continues

days.topic: SAP Build Work Zone: Sites and Launchpads
subtopics: Adding Fiori apps and Build apps
days.lab_task: Build a Work Zone site that combines the Build app, the approval inbox and an S/4HANA Fiori app, with pages visible by role.
days.deliverable: Site, role settings and screenshots for two roles
checks: Open the S/4HANA app from the site

days.topic: Getting Hands-On with SAP HANA Cloud
days.lab_task: Create a HANA Cloud instance, load a CSV of products, write SQL queries and a view, and grant a read-only user access to the view only.
days.deliverable: Instance, SQL scripts and access test
checks: Query the base table as the read-only user
Status shows stopped and billing pauses

days.topic: Introduction to the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP)
subtopics: What CAP is and why SAP recommends it
days.lab_task: Create a CAP project for a bookshop with Books and Authors entities, a catalogue service and CSV sample data, run it locally and query it through OData.
days.deliverable: CAP project and OData query results
checks: Add an Authors association and $expand it

days.topic: CAP Services: Custom Logic and Validation
days.lab_task: Add handlers to the bookshop that stop orders larger than the stock, reduce stock in the same transaction, add a submitOrder action and test every case with a REST client file.
days.deliverable: Service code and REST client test file with results
checks: Order more books than in stock
Stock decreases by the ordered amount
objectives: Add business logic to CAP services

days.topic: Fiori Elements User Interfaces for CAP
subtopics: Generating apps with the application generator
Adding the app to a launchpad
days.lab_task: Generate a Fiori elements list report and object page for the bookshop, add annotations for columns, filters and value helps, enable draft editing and preview it.
days.deliverable: Fiori elements app and annotation file
checks: Columns and filters match the annotations
Edit a book in draft and leave without saving
Draft is kept and can be resumed

days.topic: Persisting CAP Data in SAP HANA Cloud
subtopics: Moving from SQLite to HANA Cloud
days.lab_task: Deploy the bookshop schema to an HDI container on HANA Cloud, run the app locally against it with cds bind, then change the model and redeploy without losing data.
days.deliverable: HDI container, deployment logs and data check
checks: Tables are created in the container
Run the app with the hybrid profile
objectives: Persist CAP data in HANA Cloud

days.topic: Securing CAP Applications
days.lab_task: Restrict the bookshop so viewers can read, editors can change only books in their own genre and admins can delete, test with mock users and deploy the roles.
days.deliverable: Security annotations, xs-security.json and test results
checks: Delete a book as an editor
Edit a book outside the editor's genre

days.topic: Deploying Applications with MTA
days.lab_task: Package the bookshop service, HANA deployer, approuter and Fiori app as an MTA, deploy it to Cloud Foundry and add the app to the Work Zone site.
days.deliverable: mta.yaml, deployment log and running app
checks: Open the app through the approuter
Logon is required and data loads
Open the app from Work Zone
App appears as a tile and opens

days.topic: Consuming S/4HANA APIs from CAP
subtopics: Finding APIs in SAP Business Accelerator Hub
Mashing up local and remote data
days.lab_task: Import the S/4HANA business partner API into CAP, mock it locally, then call the real system through a destination and show customers alongside local notes.
days.deliverable: CAP project with remote service and demo
checks: App shows a clear error instead of crashing

days.topic: Integration Suite: First Integration Flows
days.lab_task: Build an iFlow that receives an order over HTTP, maps it to the S/4HANA sales order format, routes priority orders to an email alert and forwards all orders to S/4HANA.
days.deliverable: iFlow, mapping and monitoring screenshots
checks: Email alert is sent as well
Send an order with a bad field
Message fails with the error shown in monitoring

days.topic: Generative AI on SAP BTP: AI Core, Generative AI Hub and Joule
subtopics: SAP AI Core and AI Launchpad
days.lab_task: Use the generative AI hub to summarise product reviews stored in HANA Cloud from a CAP service, compare two foundation models and note what data leaves the system.
days.deliverable: CAP endpoint, model comparison and data flow note
checks: Returns a summary for the chosen product
Lists what is sent to the model

days.topic: Monitoring, Logging and Cost Management
days.lab_task: Add logging and an alert to the bookshop, trigger an error to receive an alert, then review usage and cost in the cockpit and list resources that could be stopped.
days.deliverable: Logs, alert email and cost review
checks: Costs per service listed with savings

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Extension App with Approval Workflow
days.lab_task: Build an equipment request app with a CAP service on HANA Cloud, a Fiori elements UI, role-based security, cost centres read from S/4HANA, an approval workflow and a Work Zone tile, then demo it.
days.deliverable: MTA project, workflow, deployed app and a 10-minute demo
checks: Submit a request above the limit
Approval workflow starts and status updates
Log on as a user without the role
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one app

intermediate.summary: For developers and consultants who have built on BTP. Covers advanced CAP modelling and services, side-by-side S/4HANA extensions with events, Fiori development, Integration Suite and API Management, process automation, Kyma, CI/CD, testing, AI services and HANA Cloud features.
prerequisites: Has built and deployed a CAP application
Knows BTP accounts, destinations and role collections
Comfortable with JavaScript or Java and Git
outcomes: Build production-grade CAP services and Fiori apps
Extend S/4HANA side by side with events and APIs
Design integrations with Integration Suite and API Management
Automate delivery and run apps on Cloud Foundry and Kyma

days.topic: Advanced CDS Modelling
days.lab_task: Model an order management domain with compositions for order items, localised product texts, temporal prices and projections for different services, and test it with sample data.
days.deliverable: CDS model, services and test queries
checks: Its items are deleted through the composition
Request product names with a German locale
Query prices for a past date
Price valid on that date returned
objectives: Use compositions, localisation and temporal data

days.topic: Advanced CAP Services: Actions, Events and Error Handling
subtopics: Error handling and messages for Fiori
days.lab_task: Add a bound approve action to orders, emit an OrderApproved event to Event Mesh, consume it in a second CAP service and return Fiori-friendly error messages.
days.deliverable: Two CAP services, event configuration and test results
checks: Event is received by the second service
Event is delivered when the consumer restarts
objectives: Build actions and events in CAP

days.topic: Side-by-Side Extensions of S/4HANA with Events
subtopics: Reading full data after an event
days.lab_task: React to S/4HANA business partner changes with a CAP extension that enriches data, writes a note back to S/4HANA with the user's identity and ignores duplicate events.
days.deliverable: Extension service, event subscriptions and monitoring
checks: Change a business partner in S/4HANA
Extension processes the event and writes the note back
Check the change history in S/4HANA
Shows the end user, not a technical user

days.topic: SAPUI5 Freestyle Development
days.lab_task: Build a freestyle UI5 dashboard for the order service with a master-detail layout, routing, OData V4 binding and an OPA5 test for the main flow.
days.deliverable: UI5 app and OPA5 test results

days.topic: Extending Fiori Elements with Flexible Programming
days.lab_task: Add a custom chart section, a custom column and a custom action to the order object page, and create an adaptation project that adds a field to a standard SAP app.
days.deliverable: Extended app and adaptation project
checks: Order updates and the page refreshes through side effects

days.topic: Integration Suite: Advanced Cloud Integration
days.lab_task: Build an iFlow that splits a batch of orders, retries failures through JMS, stores failed orders in a data store with an exception subprocess and transports it to a test tenant.
days.deliverable: iFlow, transport record and monitoring evidence
checks: Send a batch with one bad order
Good orders processed and the bad one stored
Messages retried from JMS and delivered later

days.topic: API Management on SAP BTP
subtopics: Security policies: OAuth and API keys
days.lab_task: Expose the order service through an API proxy with OAuth, a quota, caching and an API product in the developer portal, then test limits and review analytics.
days.deliverable: API proxy, product and test results

days.topic: Event-Driven Architecture with Advanced Event Mesh
subtopics: Event Mesh versus Advanced Event Mesh
tools: SAP Integration Suite, advanced event mesh
days.lab_task: Set up Advanced Event Mesh with topics for order events from S/4HANA, subscribe a CAP service and a non-SAP system, and replay events after an outage.
days.deliverable: Broker set-up, subscriptions and replay test
checks: Stop one subscriber and create orders
Events are queued and delivered on restart

days.topic: Advanced Process Automation: Decisions, Integrations and Governance
days.lab_task: Build a supplier onboarding process with decision tables, API actions to S/4HANA, a document extraction step for certificates and a visibility dashboard, then transport it.
days.deliverable: Process, dashboard and transport record
checks: Onboard a supplier with a valid certificate
Cycle time and status counts shown

days.topic: Kyma Runtime for Cloud-Native Extensions
subtopics: When to use Kyma over Cloud Foundry
days.lab_task: Deploy a containerised service and a serverless function to Kyma, expose them with API rules, bind a HANA Cloud service and react to an S/4HANA event.
days.deliverable: Kubernetes manifests, running endpoints and event demo

days.topic: CI/CD for BTP Applications
subtopics: SAP Continuous Integration and Delivery service
days.lab_task: Set up a pipeline that tests and builds the order MTA on every commit and moves it through development, test and production subaccounts with Cloud Transport Management and an approval.
days.deliverable: Pipeline configuration, transport routes and release record
checks: MTA is imported into the test subaccount

days.topic: Testing CAP Applications
days.lab_task: Write cds.test tests for the order service covering handlers, actions, authorisation and the mocked S/4HANA service, and reach 80 percent coverage.
days.deliverable: Test suite and coverage report

days.topic: SAP HANA Cloud: Calculation Views, Spatial and Vector Features
days.lab_task: Build a calculation view for sales analytics, find nearby stores with spatial functions and store product embeddings in the vector engine for similarity search.
days.deliverable: Calculation view, spatial query, vector search and timings

days.topic: Generative AI Hub and AI Services in Applications
days.lab_task: Add an AI feature to the order app that extracts data from uploaded supplier quotes, drafts an email with a grounded prompt and masks personal data, then evaluate 20 results.
days.deliverable: AI feature, orchestration configuration and evaluation
checks: Fields are extracted into the order
Draft an email with a customer phone number in the data
Number is masked before the model call
objectives: Use AI services in BTP apps

days.topic: SAP Datasphere Essentials for Developers
days.lab_task: Connect Datasphere to S/4HANA, combine sales orders with a CSV of targets in an analytic model, restrict data by region and show it in an Analytics Cloud story.
days.deliverable: Datasphere space, model and story
checks: Log on as a regional user

days.topic: Connecting Non-SAP Systems and SaaS Applications
subtopics: Mapping non-SAP data to SAP formats
days.lab_task: Connect a CRM and a ticketing SaaS to the order solution with Open Connectors and an iFlow, sync new customers into S/4HANA and receive ticket updates through a webhook.
days.deliverable: Connector configuration, iFlow and sync demo
checks: Create a customer in the CRM
Update a ticket in the SaaS tool
Webhook updates the order note in BTP
Exceed the SaaS API rate limit
Calls back off and complete later

days.topic: Mobile Apps with SAP Mobile Services
days.lab_task: Build a mobile app with the mobile development kit for warehouse staff that works offline, syncs orders when back online and receives a push notification.
days.deliverable: Mobile app and offline sync demo
checks: Change syncs when the device reconnects

days.topic: Observability for BTP Applications
days.lab_task: Add OpenTelemetry to the CAP services, follow one order across the services, Event Mesh and S/4HANA calls in traces and set alerts on errors and latency.
days.deliverable: Tracing set-up, dashboards and alert rules
checks: One trace covers every service call
All log lines for the order found

days.topic: Security Hardening for BTP Solutions
days.lab_task: Harden the order solution: provision users from a directory, store secrets in Credential Store, add audit logging for changes and fix the issues from a security checklist.
days.deliverable: Security configuration and checklist results
checks: Remove a user from the directory
Audit log records the user and change

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Event-Driven S/4HANA Extension Suite
days.lab_task: Deliver a supplier collaboration suite that reacts to S/4HANA events, exposes APIs through API Management, runs an onboarding process, has Fiori UIs, tests, a CI/CD pipeline and tracing, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline, deployed suite, dashboards and a 15-minute demo
checks: Suite updates through the event and traces show the flow
Tests pass and the suite reaches the test subaccount
Call the API above the quota
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one solution

advanced.summary: For architects and senior developers. Covers BTP enterprise architecture and governance, multitenant SaaS, the ABAP Cloud environment, infrastructure as code, advanced integration and PI/PO migration, AI and agents with Joule, Business Data Cloud, security architecture, resilience and FinOps on BTP.
prerequisites: Has delivered BTP solutions in production
Knows CAP, Integration Suite and BTP security
outcomes: Architect BTP landscapes and govern them at scale
Build multitenant SaaS and ABAP Cloud extensions
Lead integration modernisation and AI on BTP
Run secure, resilient and cost-controlled BTP platforms

days.topic: BTP Enterprise Architecture and Landscape Design
subtopics: Subaccount per stage, region or team
days.lab_task: Design a BTP landscape for a group with four business units, three regions and development, test and production stages, including connectivity, identity and shared services.
days.deliverable: Landscape design and decision records
checks: Every back-end system has a secure path

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code with the Terraform Provider for SAP BTP
subtopics: Subaccounts, entitlements and service instances as code
days.lab_task: Create a standard subaccount module with entitlements, Cloud Foundry, services and role collections in Terraform, apply it for two teams through a pipeline and detect a manual change.
days.deliverable: Terraform modules, pipeline and drift report
checks: Apply the module for two teams
Change a setting by hand and run plan

days.topic: Multitenant SaaS Applications with CAP
days.lab_task: Turn the order app into a multitenant SaaS app, subscribe two consumer subaccounts, add a tenant extension field and upgrade both tenants.
days.deliverable: Multitenant app, two subscriptions and upgrade log
checks: Tenant B's data is not visible
Both tenants get the new version with data kept

days.topic: ABAP Cloud Development in the SAP BTP ABAP Environment
subtopics: RESTful ABAP Programming Model on BTP
days.lab_task: Build a RAP business object for travel requests in the BTP ABAP environment with validations and a Fiori elements UI, transport it with gCTS and compare the effort with CAP.
days.deliverable: RAP application, transport record and comparison
checks: Create a travel request with an end date before the start
objectives: Develop with ABAP Cloud on BTP
Choose between ABAP Cloud and CAP

days.topic: Integration Modernisation: PI/PO Migration to Integration Suite
subtopics: Patterns that change in the cloud
Edge Integration Cell for on-premise runtime
days.lab_task: Assess 30 PI/PO interfaces with the migration assessment, migrate three with the migration tool, run one on Edge Integration Cell and plan the remaining waves.
days.deliverable: Assessment, migrated interfaces, test results and wave plan

days.topic: Integration Architecture and Governance at Scale
subtopics: Choosing patterns: process, data, analytics, user, thing
days.lab_task: Apply the integration solution advisory methodology to a provided landscape, assign patterns and technologies to 20 integration needs and define governance standards.
days.deliverable: Integration strategy, pattern assignments and standards
checks: Each has a pattern and a technology with a reason
Naming, versioning and error handling covered
Roles of central and federated teams defined
objectives: Set up an integration centre of excellence

days.topic: AI Agents and Joule Extensibility
subtopics: Agents calling BTP and S/4HANA APIs
days.lab_task: Build a Joule skill that answers order status questions from S/4HANA and an agent that drafts a purchase requisition for approval, then evaluate them on 20 scenarios.
days.deliverable: Joule skill, agent and evaluation results
checks: Ask Joule for an order status
Ask the agent to create a requisition

days.topic: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with the HANA Cloud Vector Engine
days.lab_task: Build an assistant that answers questions on supplier contracts stored as vectors in HANA Cloud, filtered by company code and user access, and evaluate it on 30 questions.
days.deliverable: Vector tables, CAP service and evaluation results
checks: Ask about a contract the user may see
Correct answer with the contract cited
Ask about a contract for another company code
objectives: Build RAG on SAP HANA Cloud

days.topic: SAP Business Data Cloud Architecture
subtopics: Datasphere, Analytics Cloud and Databricks integration
days.lab_task: Design a Business Data Cloud architecture that uses SAP data products, shares data with Databricks for machine learning and replaces two BW reports, with governance rules.
days.deliverable: Architecture, data product plan and governance rules
checks: Map two BW reports to the new design
objectives: Design data architectures with Business Data Cloud
Share SAP data with other platforms

days.topic: Advanced Security Architecture for BTP
subtopics: Identity federation with corporate identity providers
Authorisation management with Identity Directory and groups
days.lab_task: Design and implement zero-trust access for the SaaS app with federation to the corporate identity provider, group-based roles, Private Link to back-end systems and audit monitoring.
days.deliverable: Security architecture, configuration and audit evidence
checks: Log on through the corporate identity provider
Call the back end from outside Private Link

days.topic: Resilience, Disaster Recovery and Multi-Region Design
days.lab_task: Deploy the order app in two regions with a HANA Cloud replica, fail over during a test and measure recovery time against the target.
days.deliverable: Multi-region design, failover test record and recovery time
checks: Fail the primary region in the test
Traffic moves to the second region
Data restored to the chosen point

days.topic: FinOps and Cost Governance on BTP
subtopics: BTP commercial models: CPEA and BTPEA
days.lab_task: Analyse three months of BTP usage, allocate costs to business units, find the top savings, automate stopping idle HANA Cloud instances and forecast the next year.
days.deliverable: Cost allocation, savings plan, automation and forecast

days.topic: Platform Engineering for BTP Teams
subtopics: Golden-path templates for CAP and UI5
days.lab_task: Build a golden path that gives a new team a subaccount, a CAP template with pipeline, security and observability in under an hour, and measure the time with a pilot team.
days.deliverable: Golden path, documentation and pilot measurements
checks: Run the golden path for a new team
Working subaccount and app in under one hour
objectives: Engineer a BTP platform for teams

days.topic: Clean Core Extension Strategy Across S/4HANA and BTP
subtopics: Moving classic extensions out of the core
days.lab_task: Score 30 classic S/4HANA extensions, decide for each whether to retire, rebuild on-stack with ABAP Cloud or move to BTP, and plan the first wave.
days.deliverable: Extension inventory, decisions and wave plan
checks: Each has a score and evidence
objectives: Move extensions out of the core

days.topic: Performance Engineering for BTP Applications
days.lab_task: Load-test the order app, find the slowest service and query, fix them with query changes and caching, scale instances and show the throughput gain.
days.deliverable: Load test reports, fixes and capacity plan
checks: Baseline throughput and p95 latency recorded

days.topic: Migrating from the SAP BTP Neo Environment
subtopics: Neo end of maintenance and timelines
Inventory of Neo applications and services
Mapping Neo services to multi-cloud equivalents
days.lab_task: Inventory a provided Neo subaccount, map every service to its Cloud Foundry or Kyma equivalent, migrate one HTML5 app and one destination, and write the cut-over plan.
days.deliverable: Inventory, service mapping, migrated app and cut-over plan
checks: Every Neo service has a target or a replacement plan
objectives: Map services to the multi-cloud environment

days.topic: Testing Strategy at Scale for BTP and S/4HANA Extensions
subtopics: Test levels across CAP, UI, integration and process
Synthetic test data for SAP scenarios
Performance and security testing in pipelines
days.lab_task: Build a test strategy and pipeline stage for the SaaS product covering API contracts, event flows, UI journeys and a multitenant upgrade test, and run it against a planted break.
days.deliverable: Test strategy, pipeline stage and test report
checks: Change the S/4HANA API response in the mock
Upgrade two test tenants in the pipeline
objectives: Test BTP solutions at every level

days.topic: Operating BTP Solutions: Incidents and Support
days.lab_task: Handle three injected incidents (an expired certificate, a broken destination and an exhausted quota), restore service, find root causes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks
checks: Write a runbook for quota exhaustion

days.topic: BTP Strategy and Architecture Reviews
days.lab_task: Review two proposed BTP solution designs from a case study, find their risks, write decision records and present a BTP strategy and roadmap to a mock architecture board.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records, strategy and presentation
checks: List the risks in each design

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise BTP Platform and SaaS Product
subtopics: Landscape architecture and governance as code
days.lab_task: Deliver a BTP platform defined in Terraform hosting a multitenant SaaS product with integrations, an AI assistant grounded in HANA Cloud vectors, zero-trust security, multi-region failover and a cost model, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, SaaS app, test reports, cost model and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Tenant is provisioned with isolated data automatically
Fail over to the second region
App keeps working within the recovery target
Costs per tenant and per business unit justified
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Prove security, resilience and cost control
